title: feat: telemetry report --top, cache-clean covers edited-files
body: Adds --top N to the telemetry report to list the N largest calls (default 5) and documents it. cache-clean takes CLAUDE_CUSTOM_CACHE and also clears edited-files. sizes.py: total_bytes uses sum().

bugs.what: lists top - 1 calls instead of top
telemetry-report --top 3 LOG treats --top as the log path
an empty CLAUDE_CUSTOM_CACHE makes it rm -rf /edit-check; the path is unquoted
